title: Ripple USD stablecoin page
claim_scope: RLUSD overview, backing, redemption, availability, supported chains, NYDFS/DFSA context, BNY custody reference, and transparency summary
notes: PR-028A primary overview source. Use separate terms/transparency sources for detailed legal and reserve treatment.
